title: Bitcoin Halving 2028 Countdown: What History Suggests for the Next Cycle
summary: With the 2028 halving on the horizon, we revisit how previous supply shocks played out — and what's different this time.

body.p: Every four years, Bitcoin's block subsidy is cut in half. The 2028 halving is still roughly 18 months away by current block-time estimates, but positioning tends to begin well in advance.

body.h: What the last three halvings showed

body.p: The 2012, 2016, 2020 and 2024 halvings were each followed by new all-time highs — but the path and the lag were never identical. In 2024, price consolidated longer than many expected before the late-year breakout.

list: 2012: steepest post-halving rally, thin market depth.
2024: ETF flows changed the supply-demand structure.

body.quote: History rhymes, it doesn't repeat. Position for the mechanism, not the calendar.

body.p: For the first time, a mature ETF complex competes with exchanges for supply, and mining economics are dominated by public companies with treasury strategies. That changes both floor and ceiling behaviour.

body.note: This is market analysis, not financial advice. Nothing here is a recommendation to buy or sell.
